config.name: wiggle (continued)
config.seed_hypothesis: Build a breakout strategy around the rdp_wiggle_base primitive. This primitive uses two-pass RDP to detect structural bases: coarse epsilon finds swing lows (floor), fine epsilon measures oscillation texture via WIGGLE_SCORE (alternation * amplitude compression * curvature-without-progress). Entry triggers when price escapes the base cap after WIGGLE_SCORE qualifies. Use regime_filter to ensure macro uptrend alignment. Stop at base_floor. Target 2-3R. Focus on weekly small-cap stocks where bases form over 2-6 months before breakout. The key output ports from rdp_wiggle_base are: anchor_price (floor), cap_price (ceiling), qualify_idx (base confirmed bar), escape_idx (breakout bar), and the wiggle score components (ALT, AMP, TURN).
